name: Wide-Grip Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
cues: Lie with your chest on the pad and your feet on the platform
Take the wide handles with your palms facing down
Row with your elbows flared out to the sides
Pinch your shoulder blades at the top of each rep

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Elbow 8 to 116 with ~70 deg flare and the scapulae retracting (clavicle prot 12 to -18), matching 'pinch your shoulder blades'. The finish humerus sits 9 deg in front of the frontal plane (z +0.16 vs 306's -0.44), slightly short. Same narrow-pad decision as 338.
